tools.name: tsc
tools.note: project tsconfig.json. 9 errors discarded: TS2307 for @/lib/auth, @/lib/db, @/lib/logger (path-alias modules not in the review scope) and TS2339 toBeInTheDocument (jest-dom setup file not in scope).

findings.title: Live translation API key hardcoded in a client component
findings.why: C1: a `tr_live_` credential is sent as a Bearer token (line 32) from browser code, so it ships in the JS bundle to every visitor and stays in git history. R1: anyone loading the product page can read it. X-SEV-04: never downgraded.
findings.fix: Remove the literal, rotate the key, and call an own backend route (e.g. POST /api/reviews/:id/translate) that reads the key from a server-side env var.
findings.cite: CWE-798; CWE-200; OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures; Next.js docs, Environment Variables

findings.title: Review body and third-party translation rendered as raw HTML
findings.why: C1 stored XSS: `review.body` is text written by any reviewer and `translated[...]` is third-party API output; both reach dangerouslySetInnerHTML unsanitized, so `` in a review runs in every visitor's session. R1: anyone who can post a review. X-SEV-04.
findings.fix:
Render as text: `

{translated[key] ?? review.body}

`; if HTML is required, `DOMPurify.sanitize(...)` unchanged.
findings.cite: CWE-79; OWASP A03:2021 Injection; React docs, dangerouslySetInnerHTML

findings.title: deleteTask server action deletes any task by id with no session or membership check
findings.evidence: const { projectId } = await db.task.delete({ where: { id }, select: { projectId: true } });
findings.why: C1: 'use server' functions are public POST endpoints; unlike updateTaskStatus (line 34) this action never calls requireProjectMember, so any caller (even unauthenticated) who knows or obtains a task UUID deletes it from any project. R1.
findings.fix: Load the task's projectId first, `await requireProjectMember(projectId)`, then delete (or `deleteMany({ where: { id, project: { members: { some: { userId } } } } })`).
findings.cite: CWE-862; CWE-639; OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control; Next.js docs, Data Security (Server Actions are public endpoints)

findings.title: Module-level QueryClient on the server shares other projects' tasks across requests
findings.evidence: const serverQueryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 60_000 } } });
findings.why: C1: serverQueryClient lives for the whole server process; each ProjectBoardPage render prefetches ['tasks', projectId] into it (staleTime 60s) and `dehydrate(serverQueryClient)` serializes every cached query into the HTML, so a member of project A receives project B's tasks fetched for another user. R1: every page load.
findings.fix: Create the client per request: `const queryClient = new QueryClient(...)` inside ProjectBoardPage and dehydrate that one.
findings.cite: CWE-488; OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control; TanStack Query docs, Advanced Server Rendering (create the QueryClient per request)

findings.title: One /api/users request per review, awaited sequentially
findings.evidence:
const authorRes = await fetch(`/api/users/${review.authorId}`);
const author = (await authorRes.json()) as Author;
findings.why: C2: n+1 sequential round trips before anything renders; reviews per product are unbounded (data-controlled), so a product with 200 reviews waits for 201 requests. R1: every product page load.
findings.fix: Fetch authors in one batched call: `/api/users?ids=${[...new Set(list.map(r => r.authorId))].map(encodeURIComponent).join(',')}`, or a reviews endpoint that embeds the author.
findings.cite: CWE-1073; web.dev, Avoid chaining critical requests

findings.title: Review load has no error path: a failed fetch leaves the spinner forever
findings.why: C2: load() is fire-and-forget with no try/catch/finally and no res.ok check (lines 51, 55); any network error, non-JSON 500 page or failed author lookup rejects, setLoading(false) never runs and the user sees 'Loading reviews…' forever with an unhandled rejection. R1: main content of the component.
findings.fix: Wrap in try/catch/finally, check `res.ok` for both fetches, keep an error state rendered with role="alert", and `void load()` or use useQuery (isError).
findings.cite: React docs, error boundaries do not catch async errors; WHATWG Fetch Standard (rejects only on network errors); CWE-755

findings.title: Effect fetches reviews for productId but has an empty dependency array
findings.why: C2: when productId changes (client navigation between products reusing the component) the previous product's reviews stay on screen. R1: ordinary navigation.
findings.fix: Depend on `[productId]` and guard with an ignore flag or AbortController in the cleanup (TS-COR-12) so a slow earlier response cannot overwrite the newer one.
findings.cite: React docs, Synchronizing with Effects; React docs, Removing Effect Dependencies

findings.title: Translation cache keyed by review id only, not by target language
findings.why: C2: the translated text depends on targetLanguage but is stored under `review.id`; after the user switches language, line 101 keeps showing the old language's translation for every review already translated. R1: any language switch.
findings.fix: Key by both inputs, e.g. `${review.id}:${targetLanguage}`, and read with the same key.
findings.cite: TanStack Query docs, Query Keys (include every variable the result depends on); CWE-524

findings.title: Membership mock always grants and no test proves a non-member is rejected
findings.why: C2: findUnique always resolves to a membership and no test overrides it to null, so every test passes with requireProjectMember deleted; the authorization path of updateTaskStatus (and the missing check in deleteTask) is never tested for denial. Reachability from the code under test: the open server actions (R1).
findings.fix: Add tests that `vi.mocked(db.membership.findUnique).mockResolvedValueOnce(null)` and expect the move/delete to fail (error alert shown, db.task.update/delete not called).
findings.cite: OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 V4.1 (verify access control denies); Vitest docs, vi.mocked / mockResolvedValueOnce

findings.title: 'moves a task to done' asserts only that the mock exists
findings.why: C2: `db.task.update` is a vi.fn() and is always defined, so the test passes whether the move succeeds, fails or never calls the server (findUniqueOrThrow returns undefined here, so the action actually throws). It is the only test of the status-change persistence path. R1.
findings.fix: Mock findUniqueOrThrow/update to return rows and assert `expect(db.task.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ where: { id: TASKS[0].id }, data: { status: 'done' } })` plus the card appearing under 'Done (1)'.
findings.cite: Vitest docs, expect / toHaveBeenCalledWith; Jest docs, Expect

findings.title: Database client and server actions share a module with client components
findings.why: C2: the file imports @/lib/db, @/lib/auth and next/cache and defines 'use server' actions and an async server component, yet TaskBoard/TaskSearch use useState/useEffect/useQuery (client-only). Without a server/client split it either fails the Next.js build or, if marked 'use client', pulls the db client into the browser bundle. Assumes a Next.js App Router project, as next/cache and 'use server' show. R1: whole board.
findings.fix: Move requireProjectMember, the actions (with a file-level 'use server') and ProjectBoardPage into server modules that `import 'server-only'`; put TaskBoard and children in a 'use client' file that imports only the actions.
findings.cite: Next.js docs, Server and Client Components: Keeping server-only code out of the client environment

findings.title: Search fetch per keystroke with no abort or ignore flag: older results overwrite newer
findings.why: C2: each keystroke starts a request and none is cancelled; when 'rel' resolves after 'release', the list shows results for the stale term. R1: ordinary typing.
findings.fix: Create an AbortController per effect run, pass its signal to getTasks, abort in the cleanup and ignore AbortError (or use useQuery keyed by the debounced term).
findings.cite: React docs, Synchronizing with Effects (fetching data, cleanup); MDN, AbortController

findings.title: Optimistic task move has no rollback on error and no settle invalidation
findings.why: C2: onMutate writes the new status into the cache but saves no snapshot, there is no onError restore and invalidation runs only onSuccess; when the server action rejects (not a member, deleted task) the card stays in the new column until a later refetch while the user believes it moved. R1: every move.
findings.fix: Snapshot with getQueryData in onMutate and return it, restore it in onError, and move the invalidateQueries call to onSettled.
findings.cite: TanStack Query docs, Optimistic Updates

findings.title: TaskCard keyed by index although cards hold confirm-delete state and the list changes
findings.why: C2: TaskCard keeps confirmingDelete in state; after a task leaves the column (moved or deleted) the next task takes its index and inherits 'Confirm delete', so one click deletes the wrong task. R1: normal board use.
findings.fix: Use the stable id: `key={task.id}`.
findings.cite: React docs, Rendering Lists (keys must be stable); CWE-837

findings.title: console.log of every loaded review on each page load
findings.why: C3: unleveled debug output with review and author objects on every product page view, bypassing any logger; no secrets or PII beyond public display names. R1, so minor (X-SEV-07).
findings.fix: Delete it, or use the app's logger at debug level.
findings.cite: CWE-532; OWASP Logging Cheat Sheet

findings.title: Translate is a clickable div with no role, focus or key handler
findings.why: C3: keyboard and screen-reader users cannot reach or activate Translate, a secondary control (X-SEV-06 minor). R1.
findings.fix: `<button type="button" className="review__translate" onClick={() => void handleTranslate(review)}>Translate</button>`
findings.cite: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard (Level A); WAI-ARIA APG, Button pattern

findings.title: it.only committed: the other four TaskBoard tests are skipped locally
findings.evidence: it.only('renders one column per status', async () => {
findings.why: C2 on coverage: running the file locally executes only this test. Vitest rejects .only when CI is set (allowOnly defaults to !process.env.CI), so CI fails rather than silently narrowing; minor per the TEST-06 rule.
findings.fix: Remove `.only`.
findings.cite: Vitest docs, allowOnly; Jest docs, test.only

findings.title: Test counts cards through container.querySelectorAll on a CSS class
findings.why: C3: couples the test to markup (`.task-card`) rather than what users see; a class rename breaks it and it passes on inaccessible markup.
findings.fix: `expect(screen.getAllByRole('listitem', { name: … }))` or `within(column).getAllByRole('heading', { level: 3 })`.
findings.cite: Testing Library docs, Guiding Principles and About Queries (prefer getByRole)

findings.title: user.type is not awaited, so the assertion runs before any typing
findings.why: C3: the expect at line 68 runs synchronously before the first keystroke or search request, so 'no error while typing' passes whatever the search does (vacuous). Not the only search test, so minor.
findings.fix: `await user.type(search, 'login');` then `await waitFor(...)` or assert after the results appear.
findings.cite: user-event docs, Introduction (await every call); Testing Library docs, Async methods

findings.title: UpdatedAgo interval captures updatedAt at mount
findings.why: C3: the effect has [] deps and the label is initialised once, so when the card receives a different task or a new updatedAt (index keys at line 167, refetch after a move) the 'Updated …' label keeps describing the old timestamp. Display-only, so minor. R1.
findings.fix: Add `updatedAt` to the dependency array and recompute the label immediately in the effect (or derive the label in render from a ticking `now`).
findings.cite: React docs, Synchronizing with Effects; React docs, Removing Effect Dependencies

findings.title: `columnTasks.length &&` renders a stray 0 in empty columns
findings.why: C3: React renders the number 0, so every empty column (e.g. 'Done (0)') shows a bare '0' under its heading. R1: the default empty board state.
findings.fix: `{columnTasks.length > 0 && (` …
findings.cite: React docs, Conditional Rendering (do not put numbers on the left side of &&)

findings.title: useMemo imported but never used
findings.why: C4: unused import; reader cost only.
findings.fix: Remove `useMemo` from the import.
findings.cite: TypeScript docs, noUnusedLocals; ESLint docs, no-unused-vars

findings.title: useCallback imported but never used
findings.why: C4: unused import; reader cost only.
findings.fix: Remove `useCallback` from the import.
findings.cite: TypeScript docs, noUnusedLocals; ESLint docs, no-unused-vars

questions.question: updateTaskStatus loads the task with findUniqueOrThrow before the membership check, so a non-member gets a different error for an existing vs a missing task id. Are these errors surfaced to the client differently? If so, task ids can be probed (CWE-204).
